items.q: "we decided and talked it over, let's do something else that Glenn Miller had had going good"

ctx.x: Then I'm in Rendezvous now and so when I did the second session, it went going very good, and after this had gone so good, we decided and talked it over, let's do something else that Glenn Miller had had going good, because we saw that that was (inaudible). So we did Chattanooga Choo Choo and so then Capitol began to take notice and so Capitol contacted me and wanted to buy the contract, they wanted to buy my contract.
